userIntent: 查到哪个哪个返回: one phone cannot hold back another completed lookup
risk: R2 managed cloud scheduling/transaction boundary; local implementation only
cause: All channel reconciliation and queue admission previously shared one transaction. A device stop exception rolled back other phone results and admissions.
changes: Separate each channel reconciliation/result and each new admission into its own short transaction.
After each successful commit refresh published reservations; preserve deferred release and max5 admission checks.
Skip offline idle cleanup without releasing its reservation; exclude failed devices for a bounded current tick, continue other phones, report collected device errors.
Global owner/store failures and platform SQL-persistence failures halt further dispatch while previous results stay durable.
No-op ordinary busy/idle/stopping observations do not multiply durable writes.
Unified queue, same/new-key coalescing, per-device generation and single coordinator remain; no parallel global-state writes or Agent changes.
